channel.title: Usage Updates — kullanım limiti değişiklikleri
channel.description: Claude ve ChatGPT kullanım limiti resetleri, geçici artışları, ücretsiz erişimleri ve kredileri.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Astra kullanıma sunulunca Plus, Pro ve Business kullanıcılarına tam biriktirilebilir reset verildi
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): with GPT-6 Astra rolled out ahead of schedule, OpenAI is giving a full banked reset to all Plus, Pro, and Business users, landing by end of day; accounts created or upgraded before 8pm PT also qualify.

item.title: OpenAI — Kredi: OpenAI, hâlâ Astra'ya erişemeyen kullanıcılara ikinci bir biriktirilmiş reset veriyor
item.description: Some Plus and Business users won't yet get access to Astra today, we've got you covered with a banked reset. Lands by end of day and if you create your account by 8pm PT then you'll get it too.

item.title: Anthropic — Limit resetleme: Fable 5.1 çıkışı için Claude Max haftalık limitleri resetlendi
item.description: We've just reset weekly limits for everyone on a Claude Max plan. With Fable 5.1 out and a long weekend ahead for many of you, we wanted to keep you building. I'd love to see what you build!

item.title: OpenAI — Kredi: OpenAI, GPT-6 Astra erişimindeki her gecikme günü için biriktirilmiş reset veriyor
item.description: OpenAI will grant a banked usage reset for every day paid ChatGPT users lack access to GPT-6 Astra, starting September 3, with the first landing within hours.

item.title: Anthropic — Limit resetleme: Fable 5.1 çıkışında 5 saatlik ve haftalık limitler tüm kullanıcılar için resetlendi
item.description: With Fable 5.1 out today, we've also reset 5-hour and weekly limits for all users.

item.title: OpenAI — Ücretsiz erişim: OpenAI, ABD'li üniversite öğrencilerine 4 ay ücretsiz ChatGPT Plus veriyor
item.description: The 2026 Back to School offer gives eligible US college and graduate students four free monthly billing periods of ChatGPT Plus (an $80 value, including ChatGPT Work), verified via SheerID; claim by October 31, 2026.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: 25 milyon aktif kullanıcı için Codex ve ChatGPT Work limitleri resetlendi
item.description: What I wanted to say yesterday is that we hit 25M active users and to celebrate we have now reset usage for all paid subscriptions for ChatGPT Work and Codex. See you soon for more news from The Reset Company.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: OpenAI, Codex ve ChatGPT Work kullanım limitlerini yeniden resetledi
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “Your Codex and ChatGPT Work reset will land at 6pm PST. I challenge you to burn as much usage as you can and discover and the latest awesome features. Time to go /fast.”

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Codex ve ChatGPT Work limitleri resetlendi, düzeltmelerle kullanım %10-%50 daha uzun sürüyor
item.description: We are reseting usage for all paid users of Codex and ChatGPT Work... Depending on how you use Codex, you should see usage go between 10% and 50% further than before.

item.title: Anthropic — Limit artışı: Claude Code haftalık limitleri 13 Eylül'e kadar %50 yüksek kalıyor
item.description: Starting September 14, we're permanently raising standard weekly limits in Claude Code by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. Until then, the current 50% increase will be in place.

item.title: Anthropic — Ücretsiz erişim: K-12 okul bölgelerine Haziran 2027'ye kadar ücretsiz Claude for Teachers Enterprise erişimi
item.description: Claude for Teachers is available to schools and districts as a free Enterprise offering. Qualifying organizations that sign up by June 30, 2027 get a full year of free access.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri bir kez daha resetlendi
item.description: Never slept better and feeling reseted. Brand new me and brand new usage for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Regaining my youth one button press at a time. Happy Thursday

item.title: Anthropic — Ücretsiz erişim: Anthropic, bilim insanlarına bir yıllığına 10.000 ücretsiz ve indirimli Claude koltuğu sunuyor
item.description: We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year through our new Claude team plan for scientists.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Üç kullanım tüketen hata bulunduktan sonra Codex ve ChatGPT Work limitleri resetlendi
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): after finding usage drains from image-heavy compaction, the Computer History feature, and auto-generated conversation titles, OpenAI reset Codex and ChatGPT Work usage for all paid accounts, with more fixes promised to follow.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: 20 milyon kullanıcı için tüm Codex ve ChatGPT Work kullanıcılarına biriktirilebilir reset verildi
item.description: To celebrate reaching 20M active users this week, OpenAI credited every Codex and ChatGPT Work user with a banked reset that can be applied on the user's own schedule.

item.title: Anthropic — Limit artışı: Claude Code haftalık limitleri %50 yüksek olarak 31 Ağustos'a uzatıldı
item.description: We're extending the 50% increase to weekly Claude Code limits through August 31. We hope to make this a permanent change to our plans, but strong demand for our models means that capacity may be tight over the coming weeks. We'll keep you posted as things develop.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit artışı: ChatGPT Free tavsiye kampanyası Hindistan, Endonezya ve Meksika'da kullanım limitlerini iki katına çıkarıyor
item.description: Selected ChatGPT Free users in India, Indonesia, and Mexico can double their usage limits for seven days per successful referral, up to three times, from August 18 to September 17, 2026.

item.title: OpenAI — Ücretsiz erişim: Elevated errors in ChatGPT conversations for Free users
item.description: ChatGPT conversations for Free

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: 15 milyon aktif kullanıcı için ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri resetlendi
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “Old news actually from a bunch of days ago, but crossed that 15M. Enjoy a nice reset everyone. Landing in the next hour or so, go /fast.”

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: OpenAI, Codex ve ChatGPT Work kullanım limitlerini Pazartesi için yeniden resetledi
item.description: Usage limits have been reset for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Happy Monday you all. Hope it is a fantastic week.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: OpenAI, Codex ve ChatGPT Work kullanıcıları için söz verdiği Pazartesi resetini gerçekleştirdi
item.description: Tibo confirmed the Monday reset he had promised was delivered for Codex and ChatGPT Work: "Just like any other reset, but picture me doing a little dance with it."

item.title: OpenAI — Kredi: ChatGPT Business Premium koltuk kaydı 500 dolara kadar kredi kazandırıyor
item.description: Up to 10,000 eligible workspaces that sign up before August 20, 2026 can receive $100 in workspace credits (2,500 credits) for each qualifying Premium seat they add, up to five seats.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Sol'un CC harness'te kullanılabilir olmasını kutlamak için ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri resetlendi
item.description: That's right, GPT-5.6 Sol is awesome and can be used pretty much anywhere, including in the CC harness. To celebrate this, together with the fact that I'm not going anywhere... I have reset usage limits for all paid users of ChatGPT Work and Codex. Have fun out there!

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Codex ve ChatGPT Work limitleri “verimlilik haftası” için yeniden resetlendi
item.description: To celebrate a week of efficiency and let you run 100,000 Luna threads this weekend, I've reset usage limits for Codex and ChatGPT Work.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit artışı: OpenAI, Luna ve Terra fiyatlarını düşürdü: Codex ve ChatGPT Work kullanımı daha uzun sürüyor
item.description: Luna and Terra's lower prices are reflected in how usage is counted in Codex and ChatGPT Work, so your usage goes further.

item.title: OpenAI — Ücretsiz erişim: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, 100.000 araştırmacıya 2027'ye kadar ücretsiz Pro düzeyinde erişim sağlıyor
item.description: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers gives up to 100,000 researchers a year of free access to advanced models including GPT-5.6 Sol Pro, roughly equivalent to a $200/month ChatGPT Pro account; the program starts with 10,000 researchers and expands through 2027.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri resetlendi, Sol kullanımı yaklaşık %18 daha uzun sürüyor
item.description: I've reset usage limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users... we have not reduced usage on any subscription plans... we expect your usage to last around 18% longer during typical use of Sol.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: Codex ve ChatGPT Work limitleri tüm ücretli kullanıcılar için yeniden resetlendi
item.description: Back at the laptop. The usage limits have been reset for all paid users of Codex and ChatGPT Work. Weeeeeeeee. It's a good day!

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri neredeyse küresel kesinti sonrası resetlendi
item.description: We have reset usage limits for all Codex and ChatGPT Work users. Last night around 2am to 4am we suffered an almost global outage. All well and recovered, but you know what comes next. We learn. We reset. Enjoy.

item.title: OpenAI — Limit resetleme: 10 milyon aktif kullanıcı için ChatGPT Work ve Codex limitleri resetlendi
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “10M! New day, new usage reset for paid users of Codex and ChatGPT Work. Lands in the next hour. Enjoy.”
